nodes.name: OSM: Query Overpass
nodes.notes: Free, no API key. Be polite to the public instance — don't fire these in tight parallel batches at scale.

nodes.name: Places: Text Search (Pro fields only)
nodes.notes: Field mask deliberately excludes websiteUri/nationalPhoneNumber - those trigger the paid Enterprise SKU. Move the API key into a proper credential rather than leaving it as plain text.

nodes.name: Merge All Sources
nodes.notes: Check this node's mode dropdown after import — Merge node options differ by n8n version. You want simple concatenation of all 3 branches, not a field-matching join.

nodes.name: Append New Org Leads
nodes.notes: Create an 'Org Leads' tab first with headers matching the normalize nodes' fields: source, source_id, org_name, address, city, state, category, website, phone, ein, discovered_at
